Group

Class

An object that consists of persons that are associated to each other by some socially significant relations or recurrent interactions

Note

Groups don't include collections of persons who merely happen to have a common feature - such as the men, the persons with blonde hair, or the graduates - unless those persons also happen to be organised together or to interact with each other on a regular basis; if needed, such collections are best modelled as classes

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
